title: Abu Salem's Jail Term Extended Due to Unpaid Fine
summary: Abu Salem, a convicted terrorist, faces an extended jail term due to his failure to pay a fine of ₹16 lakh. The court has asked for clarification on whether the unpaid fine can extend beyond the 25-year extradition cap. This case raises questions about the consequences of not paying fines in Indian courts.
summary_points: Abu Salem, a convicted terrorist, is facing an extended jail term due to his failure to pay a fine of ₹16 lakh.

Abu Salem's case is part of a larger debate about the treatment of terrorists in Indian courts.
The issue highlights the complexities of dealing with convicted terrorists and their financial obligations.
